sent: This is a normal heartbeat. [pause 0.3] The S-A node fires, the atria squeeze, then the signal passes through the A-V node and both ventricles squeeze. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in A-fib. [pause 0.35] The atria no longer squeeze. [pause 0.35] They just quiver, firing hundreds of chaotic signals a minute. [pause 0.4] The A-V node lets only some of them through, so the heartbeat becomes irregularly irregular. [pause 0.45] If the patient is unstable, use synchronized cardioversion. [pause 0.35] If stable, slow the rate and think about stroke risk. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
